terminal_order_count.business_definition: Số đơn đã kết thúc (HOAN_THANH + DA_HUY) — mẫu số của tỷ lệ hủy/hoàn thành.
terminal_order_count.aggregation_behavior: Đếm bản ghi thỏa điều kiện danh mục; cộng được giữa các nhóm không giao nhau.

sql.main: WITH aggregate_rows AS (SELECT t1.thanh_pho AS "city", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "order_completion_rate", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') AS "completed_terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) AS "terminal_order_count" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) GROUP BY t1.thanh_pho) SELECT "city", "order_completion_rate", "completed_terminal_order_count", "terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "order_completion_rate") AS rank_tie_count, COUNT(*) OVER () AS rank_population_count FROM aggregate_rows ORDER BY "order_completion_rate" DESC NULLS LAST, "city" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2

sql_query: WITH aggregate_rows AS (SELECT t1.thanh_pho AS "city", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "order_completion_rate", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') AS "completed_terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) AS "terminal_order_count" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) GROUP BY t1.thanh_pho) SELECT "city", "order_completion_rate", "completed_terminal_order_count", "terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "order_completion_rate") AS rank_tie_count, COUNT(*) OVER () AS rank_population_count FROM aggregate_rows ORDER BY "order_completion_rate" DESC NULLS LAST, "city" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2

sql_by_query.q_2ddf6a9a88e0733c6fc40978: WITH aggregate_rows AS (SELECT t1.thanh_pho AS "city", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "order_completion_rate", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') AS "completed_terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) AS "terminal_order_count" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) GROUP BY t1.thanh_pho) SELECT "city", "order_completion_rate", "completed_terminal_order_count", "terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "order_completion_rate") AS rank_tie_count, COUNT(*) OVER () AS rank_population_count FROM aggregate_rows ORDER BY "order_completion_rate" DESC NULLS LAST, "city" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2
sql_by_query.q_7aa6213f32c7cdb604930256: WITH scoped_rows AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', t0.ngay_tao) AS period, t1.thanh_pho AS "city", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') AS "completed_terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) AS "terminal_order_count" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', t0.ngay_tao), t1.thanh_pho), ranked_cohort AS (WITH aggregate_rows AS (SELECT rc_t1.thanh_pho AS "city", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE rc_t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "order_completion_rate", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE rc_t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'HOAN_THANH') AS "completed_terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) AS "terminal_order_count" FROM silver.don_hang AS rc_t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS rc_t1 ON rc_t0.co_so_ma = rc_t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (rc_t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) GROUP BY rc_t1.thanh_pho) SELECT "city", "order_completion_rate", "completed_terminal_order_count", "terminal_order_count", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "order_completion_rate") AS rank_tie_count, COUNT(*) OVER () AS rank_population_count FROM aggregate_rows ORDER BY "order_completion_rate" DESC NULLS LAST, "city" ASC LIMIT 2) SELECT s."period", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.completed_terminal_order_count) / NULLIF(SUM(s.terminal_order_count), 0), 2) AS "order_completion_rate" FROM scoped_rows AS s JOIN ranked_cohort AS r ON (s."city" = r."city" OR (s."city" IS NULL AND r."city" IS NULL)) GROUP BY s."period" ORDER BY "period" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50000

methodology: Đối chiếu độc lập: truy vấn tổng hợp read-only riêng từ cùng định nghĩa chỉ số; không đọc lại số đã hiển thị.
Sai số theo đơn vị: số đếm phải khớp tuyệt đối, tiền tệ sai số ≤ 0,01, phần trăm ≤ 0,05 điểm.
Tỷ lệ/trung bình không đối chiếu bằng cách cộng hoặc lấy trung bình các nhóm.
Không dùng AI để chấm AI; không gộp các chỉ số trên thành một 'độ chính xác AI'.

metric_definitions.order_completion_rate: Phần trăm đơn hoàn thành (HOAN_THANH) trên các đơn đã kết thúc (HOAN_THANH + DA_HUY) theo ngày tạo đơn; đơn đang xử lý không vào mẫu số.
metric_definitions.completed_terminal_order_count: Số đơn HOAN_THANH trong tập đơn đã kết thúc — tử số của tỷ lệ hoàn thành.
metric_definitions.terminal_order_count: Số đơn đã kết thúc (HOAN_THANH + DA_HUY) — mẫu số của tỷ lệ hủy/hoàn thành.
